config.description: Set-and-forget configuration: columns, row geometry, UI text.

columns.description: The columns, rendered in array order. Each column reads `field` from every row object.

field.description: Row-object key this column displays. Columns with an empty field are ignored.

header.description: Header text. Empty = the field name.

pinned.description: Freeze this column at the left edge while the grid scrolls horizontally.

type.description: Display type: number/date/datetime format per config.locale; boolean renders a check/dash. The quick filter and CSV match the displayed text.

decimals.description: Number columns: fixed fraction digits (omit = as-is, max 6).

cellStyles.description: Conditional styling; the FIRST matching rule wins. A rule needs one condition (equals / gt / lt / contains) and at least one effect (color / background).

equals.description: Match when the cell value equals this.

gt.description: Match when the numeric value is greater than this (combine with lt for a band).

lt.description: Match when the numeric value is less than this.

contains.description: Match when the displayed text contains this (case-insensitive).

editable.description: Whether this column is editable when config.editable is on.

required.description: Validation: an empty value can't be committed.

pattern.description: Text columns: regex the committed value must match.

options.description: Non-empty = dropdown editor restricted to these (strings, or {value, label}).

aggregate.description: Footer aggregate over the current (filtered) view.

rowHeight.description: Row height in px (clamped 20–80). Fixed row height is what makes row virtualization exact.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale for built-in UI text (and, later, number/date formatting). Empty = the browser locale.

loading.description: Show the thin loading bar and dim the rows (stale-while-revalidate) — bind to your query's loading state.

emptyMessage.description: Badge text when the grid is configured but has no rows. The default ('No rows') follows the locale packs (labels.noRows); any other text overrides it, and '' hides the badge.

labels.description: Per-key overrides for built-in UI text. Unset keys follow config.locale (en/fr/de/es/nl/it/pt).

noRows.description: Empty-badge text (the emptyMessage default follows it).

exportCsv.description: Tooltip + accessible label of the CSV export button.

idField.description: Row-object key that uniquely identifies a row (stable identity for selection now, and for the M2 edit write-back).

rowSelect.description: Row selection: 'multi' supports Ctrl/Cmd-toggle and Shift-range on the visible (filtered + sorted) order. The selected ids live in two-way state.selection.

showToolbar.description: Show the toolbar (quick filter, selection count, export).

showExport.description: Toolbar button exporting the CURRENT view (filtered + sorted, configured columns) as CSV.

editable.description: Master editing switch: cells of columns with editable != false open typed editors (double-click / Enter / F2 / type). Edits fire onCellEdit; the grid never mutates data.rows.

allowAdd.description: Toolbar add-row button (fires onRowAdd; create + rebind yourself).

allowDelete.description: Toolbar delete button for the selected rows (fires onRowsDelete).

editMode.description: 'cell' fires onCellEdit per commit; 'batch' accumulates dirty cells (badge + Save/Discard in the toolbar, count in output.dirtyCount) and fires ONE onBatchSave.

data.description: The grid's content. The grid never mutates rows — editing (M2) will fire events for the author to persist.

rows.description: Row objects (client-side model, virtualized rendering; intended for up to ~50k rows). Bind a query returning objects, or transform a dataset.

state.description: Two-way runtime state: the grid writes user interactions back here, and writing values drives it (everything pre-settable/bindable).

sort.description: The active sort (header clicks cycle asc -> desc -> off).

quickFilter.description: Case-insensitive contains-filter across all configured columns.

selection.description: Selected row ids (config.idField values), in click order for toggles.

columnLayout.description: The user's column adjustments (drag headers to reorder, drag the edge handle to resize, the toolbar chooser to hide). config.columns stays the authoring truth; this layers on top.

order.description: Visible field order (fields listed here come first, in this order).

dirtyCount.description: Batch mode: committed-but-unsaved cell edits (0 in cell mode once write-backs land).
